results.title: My Undesirable Friends: Part I - Last Air in Moscow
results.original_title: My Undesirable Friends: Part I - Last Air in Moscow
results.overview: American filmmaker Julia Loktev, born in the Soviet Union, returned to Moscow in 2021 to make a documentary on the persistence of independent media journalism in Putin’s Russia—just months, as it turned out, before the country’s invasion of Ukraine. Structured in five chapters, Loktev’s film is an extraordinary vérité document of a moment of immense change and anxiety.

results.title: Legasi: Bomba the Movie
results.overview: After successfully rescuing several teenage climbers from Mount Kinabalu, Amir a member of the Special Tactical Rescue Operations Team (STORM) and his mentor Eddy became closer. But Eddy was involved in a tragic accident and felt guilty for the incident. When the tower of TEXVIN 118 caught fire, Amir was assigned to lead this important mission. The situation became more tense when a firefighter was also trapped inside the building. Will Amir succeed in saving them or will the past tragedy repeat itself?

results.title: Mann Binako Dhan
results.overview: The inspiring emotional journey of singer Ashok Darji from nothing to having everything.

results.title: Hermit
results.overview: Two stranded campers encounter a mute hermit who leads them through the darkening woods. As her unsettling behavior fuels their unease, they must confront the terrifying uncertainty of whether she is their savior or a malevolent predator.

results.title: Kill Tradition
results.overview: A mother who has been weathered by recent events in her life is put in a position of conflicting wants for the future and wellbeing of her daughter. Pressured by outsider entities to proceed with an annual tradition which isn’t in her best interest, the mother must navigate against what could be an unwanted reality. However, eventuality looms over the fate of her daughter.

results.title: Home Again
results.overview: Rolland, a 70 year-old man, exiled by his family due to his sexual orientation, makes peace with the past by finding himself in a small ghost town in the western part of Jalisco, San Sebastián del Oeste. Almost 40 years later, he wants to go back to his hometown, try to regain his daughter's love and be a part o his granddaughter's life.

results.title: Eric Rushton: Real One
results.overview: Eric Rushton's second ever stand-up special. This time there's a PowerPoint.

results.title: Saffron Kingdom
results.overview: After her husband is abducted in Kashmir, a traumatised woman flees to the United States with her young son to rebuild their lives.

results.title: The Breath Between Us
results.overview: A young man struggling with guilt and grief after his brother’s tragic death retreats into his own world. As he battles his inner demons, he’s forced to confront the past and navigate his way back to reality.

results.title: Olho Vivo
results.overview: A short film that portrays four people from Ceará who migrated to Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo and reflect on their attempts and changes. When fear ceased to be just fear and became the courage to be vulnerable.

results.title: Melanie
results.overview: Melanie has recently returned from Africa. She goes on holidays with three long-time friends, but their behaviour becomes increasingly odd.

results.title: Any Day of the Week
results.overview: Alexey and Tusya lived their life together for two. But after a serious diagnosis, Tusya decides that her husband should start life from the beginning, with another, very young girl. Alexey resists the new feeling, but it draws him in more and more. What should he do now, stay with his seriously ill wife or dive headlong into another life? Alexey tries to live a double life, realizing with each passing day that he will still have to make a choice...

results.title: Maralinga
results.overview: It's 1983. Deep in the Australian outback, Bill and Marsha Bundy are searching for a missing hitchhiker. Chasing a lead, they discover Maralinga - an abandoned nuclear testing site where a deadly threat waits in the fallout.

results.title: Appalheads
results.overview: Decades after leaving Appalachia, a daughter returns to eastern Kentucky to excavate her father’s remarkable filmmaking legacy and examine the pull home still has on her.

results.title: Bloom
results.overview: Autumn struggles with her mental health and an overbearing mother. A new support group gives her hope, but something more to the group lies beneath the surface.

results.title: George Civeris: A Sense of Urgency
results.original_title: George Civeris: A Sense of Urgency
results.overview: In this sharp and surreal stand-up special, George Civeris riffs on the child he'll never raise, the Shakespearian nature of straight weddings, and our equine savior. It's hilariously personal, fully absurdist, and oddly poetic.

results.title: Sins of the Father
results.overview: When a desperate kidnapper invades her church as she’s cleaning up alone after service, organist Mary must rely on her wits and her faith to save herself—and the young woman he’s taken captive.
